claim: Judgments that experience is inexplicable may be sensitive to semantic framing independent of any change in the phenomenally targeted experience; the unitary Hard Problem may lack a positive residual after proper decomposition.
boundary: human survey participants for judgment; philosophical target is a propositional problem-form
timescale: trial, repeated reflective judgment, philosophical comparison

rivals.mechanism: cognitive genealogy/semantic framing influences gap judgment
stable modal intuitions with defensible independent inference
unitary Hard Problem has indispensable positive surplus

variables.name: R
variables.observation_route: adversarial expert comparison with stable target

variables.name: X
variables.definition: prior philosophy, language, comprehension and culture

differential_predictions.outcome: relevant judgement change with irrelevant framing after comprehension controls
stable reasons that predict cross-framing calibration
nonreconstructible joint relation survives adversarial decomposition
no explanatory content lost after all relations restored

controls: Counterbalanced texts; comprehension checks; independent raters; neutral phrasing; preregister culturally appropriate translations
held_out_plan: Hold out participants and wording sets; separate philosophical expert critique from empirical sample.
loss_conditions: Stable independently grounded modal judgments challenge genealogy
framing study cannot identify phenomenal state
update_rule: Changes to J do not alter E by assumption; update genealogy and unitary problem-form separately; no derivation of physicalism.
provenance: Consciousness Naturalized #2115, methods and Part IX
Private 2026-11-10 methodological audit; prospective reasoning, not observed outcomes

authorization.scope: Publish proposal; participant intervention requires separate authorization and review

data_status: No outcome dataset selected or analyzed for this protocol
ethical_notes: Do not dismiss participants' experiential evidence because of philosophical background
